title: docs(skills): objectstack-i18n lists every top-level translation group and the nested form, tab and approval keys
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Gmf9pt5QnfhyXoGbpSn5Bn)_
Fixes #26296
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 的对象子键表补上表单视图自己的 `title`(`_views`)和表单分区条目的 `label` / `placeholder` / `helpText`(`_sections.{section}.fields`);顶层分组清单补齐 `picklists`、`reports`、`positions`、`permissions`,并各用一行写明页面 `page:tabs` 条目标签与审批步骤标签的键路径,以及 `os i18n extract --no-objects-only` 会把它们一并生成。评测文件加两道题(报表 + 权限集 + 岗位 + 选项列表;四个嵌套键)。评测文件 token 天花板按你的裁决从 1004 提到 1451。
- 为什么改:18.2 的翻译包多了 `reports`、`positions`、`permissions` 分组和这几个嵌套键,技能里的清单读起来像是完整的,AI 作者照着写 zh-CN 包就会漏掉报表、岗位和权限集,而且没有任何提示。
- 风险与回滚:只改一份已发布技能的文字、它的评测文件和棘轮脚本里的一行天花板数;不发包、不改代码、不改 schema。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个提交。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` L169–L181(顶层分组清单与两条嵌套键);② 同文件 L163、L165(`_views` 的 `title`、`_sections` 的 `fields`);③ `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` L657–L667(天花板行 1004 → 1451 与引用的裁决)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期退出 0,且印出 `bundles-locales-coverage.json is 1451 tokens (ceiling 1451; headroom 0)` 与 `SKILL.md is 5282 tokens (ceiling 6333; headroom 1051)`。
- 需要你做的:批准(Tier H,`skills/**` 为对外发布面;席位不会 ready、不会入队)。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (503 → 512 lines; 5028 → 5282 tokens, headroom 1305 → 1051, no ceiling moved):

- `_views.{view_name}` row: adds `title` — a form view's own heading, translated only where the form authors one; a list view has none (`translation.zod.ts` 303–320).
- `_sections.{section_name}` row: adds `fields.{field_name}` with the `label`, `placeholder`, `helpText` an entry overrides for that form alone, and says why the spelling is `helpText` here and `help` one row up (`translation.zod.ts` 455–490: each spells what its source does).
- Top-level group list: now names every group the per-app bundle declares — `picklists` (pre-18.0, previously unlisted), `reports`, `positions`, `permissions` added, each with the one line an author needs (`reports` / `positions` / `permissions` hold `label` + `description` by name; `picklists` holds `label` + `options` by stored value, inherited by every field referencing the picklist; `permissions` is spelled as the stack's `permissions[]`).
- One line each for the two keys that sit deeper than their group's `label`: `pages.{page}.components.{tabs_id}.items.{value}.label` (keyed by the item's `value`; no `value`, no key) and `flows.{flow}.approvals.{node_id}.label`, plus the scaffold that writes them: `os i18n extract --no-objects-only` — every group above but `messages` and `settingsCommon`, which the extractor never emits — (the default `--objects-only` emits only `objects` / `globalActions`; `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` 63–131 lists the walk).

`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` (55 → 75 lines; 1004 → 1451 tokens):

- The `--objects-only` warning paragraph names the `dataset`, `report`, `picklist`, `position` and `permission` coverage kinds `os i18n check` reports beside the six it listed (review item 3).
- Eval 6 — the card's acceptance eval: a report, a permission set, a position and a picklist; negative pins `permissionSets` and the singular `report: {` alias.
- Eval 7 — the four nested keys (form `title`, section entry `placeholder`, `page:tabs` item, approval step); negative pins `stepLabel` and an object-level `_tabs.overview` key.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the eval file's CEILINGS row 1004 → 1451 (+447, the measured size of the two prompts), with the ruling quoted on the row.

Package reading (SKILL.md + `references/**/*.md` + `rules/**/*.md`): 533 → 542 lines (`references/_index.md` 30 → 30, generated, unchanged). Authored tokens 6032 → 6733.

Nothing is removed: the card names no stale line, and the line that existed (the group list) is extended, not replaced.

## Why

The skill's enumerated lists read as complete. The bundle gained `reports`, `positions` and `permissions` as top-level groups, the section entry overrides, the form view title, the page tab item and the approval step label, and none of them was taught — so an AI author shipping a zh-CN pack from this page leaves reports, positions and permission sets in English, and nothing reports a missing key (audit row I1–I5 of the skills gap audit; `priority:p1`, 18.2 headline rows).

### The token ceiling

The eval file sat at zero headroom (1004 / 1004) under the shrink-only `check-skills-token-ratchet`. The maintainer ruled on the seat thread's decision card, question 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」, tap label verbatim and untranslated:

> 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」

Paid down first: the eval file carried no duplicated content to delete (five prompts, five distinct surfaces — bundle authoring, a new locale, the `translation` item, a plugin's generated bundle, the `--objects-only` diagnosis), so the remainder is the whole addition, 447 tokens, and the row is pinned at the measurement with zero headroom. SKILL.md needed no raise (1075 tokens of headroom remain). Arithmetic: evals +447 (ceiling +447), SKILL.md +254 (ceiling +0); bundle +701, ceilings +447.

## Tests

No package is touched, so no package test or typecheck is owed. The gate script edited (`check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) carries its own `--self-test`, which ran green on the final tree; no `*.test.*` file names that script (`git grep -l check-skills-token-ratchet -- '*.test.*'` returns nothing).

## Acceptance notes

- The `--objects-only` warning paragraph in the same file (L394–L398 before this PR) still lists the coverage kinds as `app`, `navigation`, `dashboard`, `widget`, `page` and `flow`; `os i18n check` also reports `report`, `picklist`, `position` and `permission` buckets (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` 356–384, 450–454). Fixed in this PR at the review's suggestion (rework `6181b122`, inside SKILL.md's headroom; now L402–406).
- The spec line references in the card body (`translation.zod.ts:602-608, 724, 1140-1143`) do not match `origin/main` at 756220c4; the readings used here are `reports` 1161–1168, `positions` 1698–1705, `permissions` 1721–1728, `picklists` 902–911, `_views.title` 320, tab items 1353–1359, `approvals` 1668–1680, `_sections.fields` 476–490.
- The card's「`:165` adds `fields.FIELD` (`label`, `placeholder`, `helpText`)」is right as written: under `_sections.SECTION.fields.FIELD` the canonical key is `helpText` (`help` is the alias); only the object-level `fields.FIELD` spells it `help`. No duplicate object-level `fields` row was added.
- `skip-changeset`: the skills package carries no `package.json`; `scripts/**` ships in no package's `files[]`.

## Human Minimum

[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema or runtime file is touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (Only eval fixture names, all `snake_case` machine names.)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran (none did); `pnpm lint` is the repo-level scan CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` owns — not run locally.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main` (756220c4), one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset — this one publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`); both declaration lines are filled in above.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: no.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 brief is Chinese by the repo's communication rule for maintainer-facing summaries).
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (Every item holds except `pnpm lint`, which is not run locally; the change reaches no package test, updates the documentation it is about, publishes nothing, carries nothing unrelated, and touches no auth surface.)
